title: Optimize window partition construction
constraints: Preserve window function ordering, partition, and default-value semantics
rationale: Window functions without PARTITION BY currently build an identical empty partition key for every row before processing a single partition. Adding a no-partition fast path avoids per-row empty key allocation, while preallocating partition maps and keys reduces growth in partitioned windows.
steps: Use a direct all-row partition when PARTITION BY is empty
Preallocate the partition map from row count for partitioned windows
Preallocate each partition key from partition expression count
Verify partitioned and unpartitioned window functions
expected_impact: Reduces allocation churn in window function execution without changing result order or function semantics.
